prompt: Create an original 180 second downtempo electronica instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: analog bass, soft breakbeat, electric piano, pluck synth. Style: steady restrained broken beat with wide atmospheric space. Tempo approximately 82 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A calm, atmospheric electronic track featuring evolving synth pads, a steady beat, and a melancholic piano melody. It builds subtly with additional synth layers and a driving bassline, creating a reflective and slightly somber mood.
description.zh: 一首平静、大气的电子乐曲，以不断变化的合成器铺底、稳定的节拍和忧郁的钢琴旋律为特色。它通过额外的合成器层和驱动的低音线巧妙地构建，营造出一种沉思而略带忧郁的氛围。
